scope: CPU read-only source/checkpoint metadata audit; no engine import/launch, policy forward/rollout, training, optimizer, checkpoint write or installation

normalization.freeze: model.eval(), requires_grad_(False), inference_mode(); no RMS update; normalize exactly once
normalization.invalid_rejection: Wrong rank/size/dtype/device, NaN/Inf, negative variance, nonpositive count or mutated epsilon/clip rejected; never use identity replacement

actor.architecture: 19 -> 2-layer LSTM(input=19,hidden=1024,dropout=0) -> LayerNorm1024(eps1e-5) -> MLP512 ELU ->128 ELU ->64 ELU ->mu6 identity; sigma/logstd6 and value1 unused for deterministic command except RNG sample consumption
actor.reset: zeros at initial observation; zero only done actor columns after returned reset and before first next action; never restore checkpoint runtime h/c
actor.rng: FrozenPolicy consumes/discards original Normal(mu,exp(logstd)).sample() before choosing mu; seed identity across MuJoCo and PhysX is not evidence of matched reset streams

observation_rows.name: fingertip_pos_rel_fixed.x
observation_rows.reference_frame: world axes, env-origin-subtracted positions; reference point is cached at reset, not a rotating coordinate frame

observation_rows.observable_without_privileged_state: NO: fixed reset pose truth is simulator-derived. Robot encoders alone do not determine it; calibrated sensing/perception would be a different interface

critical_privileged_dependency.description: Actor position subtracts cached simulator fixed-asset root truth transformed to top tip plus per-episode 1mm Gaussian noise. This is not camera or external perception output; cache reset also uses this reference. Robot observations alone cannot reconstruct hole root pose. Critic43D is excluded, but actor is not privilege-free.

velocity_update_contract.pose_history_update: _apply_action recomputes only for a new _sim_timestamp; _get_dones computes final physics interval before observations; no policy-window average
velocity_update_contract.reset: Store current joint/TCP pose as previous; FD linear/angular buffers zeroed before initial observation

success.frame: World/environment axes of current held/fixed roots; env origin cancels; not fixed-root local axes and not fixed observation tip
success.target_program_proposal: Read target engine exact held/fixed ROOT frame current poses (not COM and not observation tip); compose zero local offsets; execute same float32 torch.linalg.vector_norm and strict comparisons before auto-reset. Do not replace by sqrt-distance to tip, abs(z), orientation, contact or tolerance padding.
success.threshold_precision: Source height*threshold is a Python float then compared in Torch FP32; target must match expression and dtype. Boundary equality fails.

ordering: zero done actor LSTM columns before next action
termination_and_metrics.ever_success: OR of each official pre-reset step mask, steps1..149
termination_and_metrics.terminal_success: official current mask at final pre-reset done step
termination_and_metrics.first_success: min official 1-based episode counter with true success; seconds=step*8/120
termination_and_metrics.reset_auxiliary_physics: IK/grasp and reset step_sim_no_action add physics time outside149 policy steps; they must not be counted as independent policy observations or successes

mujoco_primary_sources.supports: body xpos/xquat/xmat, site_xpos/site_xmat are Cartesian kinematic outputs; distributed scalar mjtNum double; body frame differs from xipos COM
quaternion scalar-first convention and local parent frames; compiled angles radians; orientation sign parity not guaranteed
qpos quaternion dimension differs from qvel; do not equate quaternion derivative/qvel to source finite differences

unresolved.item: Exact original panda_fingertip_centered body/site local frame in selected MuJoCo robot asset and its raw quaternion sign convention; requires licensed exact model reconstruction and CPU matched-pose traces before G4-S1 rollout
19D target semantic reconstruction is credible given calibrated exact frames plus explicit privileged fixed geometry and cached reset noise; target implementation absent
PhysX/MuJoCo trajectories and contacts, reset random streams and actor commands will match; no bitwise or policy transfer performance claim
